title: Each tile's report link opens its matching report on the tile's dates
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. The location has invoiced work with clocked technician time last month and this month.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Technician Efficiency on Last Month and on This Month each shows a percentage (not -); then set the pill back to This Month (date ranges are not remembered: every visit opens on the defaults). If this month has none, create one invoice with clocked time today: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). Last month cannot be created by hand: if no location has it, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Hover the small square-and-arrow icon beside the name Revenue and read the tooltip.
  3. Repeat the hover on the icon beside Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization and Sales by Customer.
  4. Look beside the name At Risk Customers.
  5. Set the Revenue pill to Last Month, open the pill again and write down the dates at the top of the calendar (e.g. Sep 1, 2026 — Sep 30, 2026), then press Escape.
  6. Click the icon beside Revenue (if the report opens in a new browser tab, use that tab).
  7. Read the report's title and open its Date control to read the dates it covers.
  8. Go back to the Dashboard.
  9. Do the same for Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization and Sales by Customer at their default ranges, writing down the tile's dates first.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each of the five tiles shows the report icon beside its name, and hovering it shows a tooltip naming the report it opens (e.g. Sales report for Revenue). Write the tooltip text in the result comment.
  • Clicking the icon opens the matching report: Revenue opens Sales, Billing Efficiency opens Service Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency opens Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization opens Technician Utilization, Sales by Customer opens Sales By Customer.
  • Each report opens covering the same dates the tile showed (e.g. Sep 1, 2026 to Sep 30, 2026 for Revenue on Last Month).
  • At Risk Customers has no report icon beside its name.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v48, read 14 Oct 2026, Story 10. Context note listing the tile-to-report links. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, as re-shared and read 14 Oct 2026; screenshots of the SV-490 build re-shot on 14 Oct 2026) boards 02_Last12_After (arrow beside the name opens the report) and 09_AtRisk_After (no report arrow), used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R1: “Each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile shows a report link.”
  • S10-R4: “Hovering a tile's report link shows a tooltip naming the report the link opens.”
  • S10-R2: “Selecting a tile's report link opens that tile's matching report.”
  • Context note (Story 10, which report each tile opens): “the tile-to-report links are — Revenue → Sales report; Billing Efficiency → Service Advisor Analysis report; Technician Efficiency → Technician Efficiency report; Technician Utilization → Technician Utilization report; Sales by Customer → Sales By Customer report.”
  • S10-R3: “The report opens with the date range the tile currently shows.”
  • S10-N1: “The At Risk Customers tile shows no report link, because there is no At Risk report.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
